// CASE dart_switch_expr expect=fire
Future<void> inOrder<T>(Iterable<T> items, Future<void> Function(T) step, {required String reason}) async {
  for (final item in items) {
    consume(await step(item), switch (item) { _ => await save(item) });
  }
}
// CASE dart_record expect=fire
Future<void> inOrder<T>(Iterable<T> items, Future<void> Function(T) step, {required String reason}) async {
  for (final item in items) {
    final (a, b) = (await step(item), await save(item));
  }
}
// CASE dart_null_aware expect=fire
Future<void> inOrder<T>(Iterable<T> items, Future<void> Function(T) step, {required String reason}) async {
  for (final item in items) {
    consume(await step(item), cache[item] ?? await save(item));
  }
}
// CASE dart_index_target expect=fire
Future<void> inOrder<T>(Iterable<T> items, Future<void> Function(T) step, {required String reason}) async {
  for (final item in items) {
    cache[await key(item)] = await step(item);
  }
}
// CASE dart_map_literal expect=fire
Future<void> inOrder<T>(Iterable<T> items, Future<void> Function(T) step, {required String reason}) async {
  for (final item in items) {
    consume({'step': await step(item), 'audit': await save(item)});
  }
}
// CASE dart_spread_distinct expect=fire
Future<void> inOrder<T>(Iterable<T> items, Future<void> Function(T) step, {required String reason}) async {
  for (final item in items) {
    consume(await step(item), [...await save(item)]);
  }
}
// CASE dart_simple_interp_then_await expect=fire
Future<void> inOrder<T>(Iterable<T> items, Future<void> Function(T) step, {required String reason}) async {
  for (final item in items) {
    consume(await step(item), '$item ${await save(item)}');
  }
}
